title: CMake+etc: Enable Qt6 by default
description:
Enable Qt6 by default and explicitly disable it for slower or more
conservative Linux distros.

Drop experimental status for Qt6, because we are using it to build
official Windows and macOS releases.

notes.body:
Isn't Qt6 disabled for all builds by default? Btw, it was agreed, that after the RC release of 4.0, we move -dev to Qt6 as default. Your change is better than mine so I will close mine. 

But I would change the text to reflect, that we move all builds to Qt6 by default
Right, you are correct, it's default off for all source builds. I misspoke and took the release CI configuration to mean "all (Windows/macOS) builds".
changed title from **CMake+etc: Enable Qt6 by default{- for Unix builds-}** to **CMake+etc: Enable Qt6 by default**

added 7 commits
  • 731e00a6...6b35aa07 - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • b3321075 - CMake+etc: Enable Qt6 by default for Unix builds
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7862/diffs?diff_id=466194834&start_sha=731e00a6acb2539286bded5d334ab767b5aa7a2d)
The RPM builds need some tweaking, I will do it later if no one else does.

Fedora does provide Qt6, adding qt 6 to `tools/rpm-setup.sh` (and other similar setup scripts in the tools directory for non RPM builds) would make the Docker container pick that up.

Ubuntu focal doesn't have Qt6. We're still on Focal (after switching to Jammy and switching back) because of #18191  (the Valgrind DWARF 5 issue).
There's also OpenSUSE and Rocky Linux to consider so the RPM setup script should support Qt5 and Qt6 somehow, either automagically or with a command line option.

Yes.

Separately, Qt6 on Fedora has issues anyways with gcc 12.1 and Qt6, giving bogus -Werror=stringop-overflow warning/errors for things in the Qt6 codebase itself.

What's the status of Qt6Multimedia - #18115 ?  

Is it time to update the WSDG and make Qt6 the standard and a note on optional modules like Qt6Multimedia?
Yes, I would say the WSDG could be updated in regard to Qt6Multimedia. I will submit a patch later today.

commits_data.title: CMake+etc: Enable Qt6 by default for Unix builds
commits_data.message:
CMake+etc: Enable Qt6 by default for Unix builds

Linux builds were left behind on the Qt transition, presumably because
our Ubuntu CI image does not support Qt6.

Enable Qt6 by default and explicitly disable it for slower or more
conservative Linux distros.

Drop experimental status for Qt6, because we are using it to build
official Windows and macOS releases.
